actions.script:
def scope=ec.service.sync().name('zenith.barcode.BarcodeServices.get#AuthorizedActiveOrganization').call(); def org=scope.activeOrgId
found=false;if(!org)return def value=barcodeValue?.trim();if(!value)return def aliases=ec.service.sync().name('zenith.barcode.BarcodeServices.get#ScanAliases').parameters([code:value]).call().aliases def matches=ec.entity.find('zenith.erp.barcode.ProductBarcode').condition('organizationPartyId',org).condition('barcodeValue','in',aliases).condition('isActive','Y').list() def ids=matches.collect{it.productId} as Set def disabled=ec.entity.find('zenith.erp.barcode.ProductBarcode').condition('organizationPartyId',org).condition('barcodeValue','in',aliases).condition('isActive','N').list().collect{it.productId} as Set ec.entity.find('mantle.product.Product').condition('ownerPartyId',org).condition('pseudoId','in',aliases).list().each{if(!disabled.contains(it.productId))ids.add(it.productId)} if(ids.size()!=1)return // Ambiguous legacy data must not choose a product arbitrarily. def prd=ec.entity.find('mantle.product.Product').condition('ownerPartyId',org).condition('productId',ids.first()).one() if(!prd || prd.ownerPartyId!=org)return found=true;productId=prd.productId;productName=prd.productName;listPrice=prd.mrpAmount;barcodeTypeEnumId=matches ? matches[0].barcodeTypeEnumId : 'BctInternal'

def access=ec.service.sync().name('zenith.barcode.BarcodeServices.assert#RecordAccess').parameters([kind:'product',recordId:productId,write:false]).call(); if(!access.allowed) return; def record=access.record barcodes=ec.entity.find('zenith.erp.barcode.ProductBarcode').condition('productId',productId).condition('organizationPartyId',record.ownerPartyId).condition('isActive','Y').orderBy('-isPrimary,barcodeId').list()
